description: Find frames in FrameThrower's ANIMATION library — animated series and films only, never live-action (mostly anime, plus Western animation; the whole of every title, not a sample) for a scene, a moment or a CHARACTER LOOK, described in plain words: "a girl on a rooftop at dusk watching the city lights", "two kids running through a summer field", "a tall man with a scarred face and a long black coat, rain". Narrow by title, genre, theme, style (80s cel, watercolour, neon night…), studio, movie/series and year. Each frame has a caption of what is in it, a 640px still for looking at, the full-size still, the frame id and a link. At most 3 frames per title unless per_title says otherwise.

clips.description: true = also return each frame's clip and sequence videos (1 credit per video on top of the call). Ask only when the user wants to see it move.

exclude_titles.description: Slugs to leave out (e.g. titles already used)

genre.description: AniList genre: Action, Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Fantasy, Horror, Mecha, Mystery, Psychological, Romance, Sci-Fi, Slice of Life, Sports, Supernatural, Thriller… (several, comma-separated = all)

nsfw.description: false = leave out frames flagged as adult (included by default)

query.description: The scene or character in plain words, as a description of one frame

style.description: The title's look, read off its frames (several, comma-separated = all): hand-drawn cel, digital 2D, 3D CGI, cel-shaded 3D, stop motion, mixed 2D/3D, 70s look, 80s look, 90s look, 2000s look, modern look, pastel, muted, vivid, dark, warm, cool, monochrome, clean lines, thick outlines, sketchy lines, painterly, watercolour, flat minimal, detailed backgrounds, film grain, realistic proportions, moe big-eyed, chibi, western cartoon, gritty mature, bishonen, soft natural light, dramatic light rays, glow and bloom, neon, high-contrast shadows

theme.description: AniList theme tag: Cyberpunk, Post-Apocalyptic, Iyashikei, Coming of Age, Time Travel, Magic, Space, Urban Fantasy…

title.description: Only inside this series / film (slug or name)

name: search_animation_frames
